cookies.name: scoutSections:<screen name> (browser storage)
cookies.why: Remembers which sections of an edit screen a signed-in editor left open. It is used only inside the site's dashboard, never on public pages, and holds no personal information.
cookies.lasts: Until the browser's saved site data is cleared

notes: Scout Core keeps no information about visitors. Its email guard only changes how email addresses are written into the page, and it stores nothing.
